errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly states that the image is not available, while the image is clearly provided and contains a bar chart.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart illustrates percentage values for three different years (2022, 2023, 2024) across months.
The machine-generated description does not describe the x-axis (months labeled with Roman numerals) or the y-axis (percentage values labeled as '%').
The machine-generated description does not mention the grouped bar structure, the color coding (blue for 2022, orange for 2023, gray for 2024), or the value ranges and intervals on the y-axis.
The machine-generated description does not highlight the highest value (2022 in December, exceeding 120,000) or the lowest value (2023 in July and December, at 80,000).
